jobs.name: kyverno-review-digest
jobs.prompt: Build the merge sequence for the maintainer's KYVERNO_REPO. Post a short, scannable digest: what changed since the last digest, and the current review order with one-line reasons - not a full brief per PR.
jobs.paused_reason: shipped paused by distribution; maintainer resumes after reviewing the schedule/channel

jobs.name: kyverno-memory-sweep
jobs._frequency: Every 5 days at 07:00, server-local time. schedule.expr: '0 7 */5 * *' (the day-of-month-divisible-by-5 approximation standard cron uses for 'every N days' — mostly every 5 days, with an occasional skip/double at a month boundary).
jobs.prompt: Silent backend sweep for KYVERNO_REPO, not a maintainer-facing report. Since your last run: (1) find PRs that closed without merging - for each with a known reason (an explicit maintainer comment, or a clear closing comment), mnemosyne_remember a short note: the PR, its topic, and why it didn't merge. (2) Check whether any e2e-failure tracking issue opened or closed - for each, mnemosyne_triple_add(subject=<the touched package-pair if determinable from the merged PRs implicated>, predicate='e2e_failure_opened' or 'e2e_failure_closed', object='<date>, <issue number>'); when a specific merged PR's package combination is clearly implicated, also add a separate triple with predicate='caused_e2e_failure'. Only these five predicates exist - never invent another. If nothing new was found, reply with exactly [SILENT]. If something was found, reply with one short line per new item - this is the only case anything gets posted anywhere.
jobs.paused_reason: shipped paused by distribution; maintainer resumes after reviewing the schedule/channel

jobs.name: kyverno-memory-consolidate
jobs._frequency: Weekly, Sundays at 06:00, server-local time. schedule.expr: '0 6 * * 0'. Deliberately less frequent than kyverno-memory-sweep — consolidation compresses whatever the sweep already wrote; it doesn't need to run right after every sweep.
jobs.prompt: Call mnemosyne_sleep to consolidate accumulated memory entries into distilled patterns. This is a purely mechanical maintenance step, not a maintainer-facing report - reply with exactly [SILENT] regardless of outcome.
jobs.paused_reason: shipped paused by distribution; maintainer resumes after reviewing the schedule
